name: DMD 5531
title: Game System Design
description: Students will be challenged to create a new game system within an existing game engine. This system will expand and change existing gameplay based on an in-class prompt. They will utilize their knowledge of player psychology and their analysis of other gameplay systems to develop a deeper understanding of the internal mechanics of games.
requirement_description: DMD 5500; open to Graduate Digital Media and Design students, others with instructor consent.
